bundle.shortDescription: A sampler and sequencer in the shape of a classic drum machine.
bundle.longDescription: Chop Deck is a sampler and sequencer shaped like a late-90s hardware drum machine: sixteen pads, a green LCD, a sequencer with swing, sampling and chopping, a mixer with effects, song mode, MIDI. The desktop app is the same machine as chopdeck.com, working entirely offline; projects save to your disk as .CHOPDECK files.
